About

WALS feature map

Pick a feature. Each language with a value is a dot, coloured by its value. The list beside the map is also the filter.

Scroll or pinch to zoom, drag to move, tap a dot for the language.

About this map

Feature values are from WALS Online (Dryer and Haspelmath, eds., 2013), CLDF release v2020.4, licensed CC BY 4.0. Each dot is the representative point WALS gives a language, not the area where it is spoken. With a second feature, only languages that have a value for both and pass both filters are shown; the colours follow the first feature.

WALS Online · WALS CLDF data · Land: Natural Earth (public domain)
